# Receipts written by consilience 0.1.1

Written once, on 20 Nov 2026, by consilience 0.1.1 (branch `nanopub-live` @09d95f0), **before** any 0.2.0 change. They use the same inputs as `../receipts-0.1.0/`, read from JSON files (the way the command line and most users make receipts).

**Never regenerate these files.** `tests/test_old_receipts.py` checks that every later version still verifies them.
